Subject: Your divorce by mutual consent matter - Petition No. 2153/2022

Dear Ms. Patel,

Thank you for meeting us on 29 December 2022 about your dispute with Aarti Fernandes. As we understand it, both spouses have lived apart for a long time.

Our advice is to apply to waive the statutory cooling-off period. Please collect proof of separate residence and the consent terms and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of Rs 23,40,000.

Regards,
Adv. Sharmila Venkatesan
